note: Subjects/9701 Chemistry/07 Equilibria/7.1 Chemical equilibria: reversible reactions, dynamic equilibrium.md
outline: Dynamic equilibrium in a closed system has continuing forward and reverse reactions at equal rates. Le Chatelier’s principle predicts how position responds to a disturbance. Equilibrium constants use concentrations or partial pressures at equilibrium; only temperature changes their values. Industrial conditions balance yield, rate and cost.

misconceptions.refutation: Both reactions continue at equal rates in a closed system; concentrations stay constant.
misconceptions.contrast: Both reactions continue at equal rates in a closed system; concentrations stay constant.

misconceptions.statement: A catalyst moves the equilibrium position
misconceptions.refutation: A catalyst speeds both directions and does not change equilibrium composition.
misconceptions.contrast: A catalyst speeds both directions and does not change equilibrium composition.

misconceptions.statement: Include a pure solid in the Kc expression
misconceptions.refutation: Pure solids have constant activity and are omitted from the expression.
misconceptions.contrast: Pure solids have constant activity and are omitted from the expression.

misconceptions.statement: Use moles in a Kp expression
misconceptions.refutation: Kp uses equilibrium partial pressures, found from mole fractions and total pressure.
misconceptions.contrast: Kp uses equilibrium partial pressures, found from mole fractions and total pressure.

misconceptions.statement: Pressure changes K at constant temperature
misconceptions.refutation: Only temperature changes the equilibrium constant; pressure can change composition.
misconceptions.contrast: Only temperature changes the equilibrium constant; pressure can change composition.

9701-7.1.1.motivate: Equal forward and reverse rates helps predict what an equilibrium mixture does in a chemical process.
9701-7.1.1.establish: A reversible reaction proceeds in both forward and reverse directions; in a closed system dynamic equilibrium has equal forward and reverse rates and constant reactant and product concentrations.
9701-7.1.1.connect: Use this with closed system when interpreting a reversible reaction at equilibrium.
9701-7.1.1.note:
- A reversible reaction proceeds in both forward and reverse directions; in a closed system dynamic equilibrium has equal forward and reverse rates and constant reactant and product concentrations.
- Check the balanced equation and equilibrium conditions before applying this rule.
